finding: Final Pi session history can omit a failed assistant reply after a successful retry. It is not by itself a complete usage ledger.
policy: Use complete durable request/assistant/retry events plus final history. Zero usage on an interrupted response remains unknown; never infer free retries. Preserve original receipts and independent patch acceptance separately from budget success.
scope: Confirmed in this pilot; no claim that all prior campaigns lost cost, and no retroactive score change.
